volume-converter.quickAnswer: Enter the volume, pick the unit you have and the one you want. The tool converts instantly with exact definitions — 1 US gallon = 3.785411784 litres — ideal for recipes and lab work.
keyFacts: The litre is defined as exactly one cubic decimetre (0.001 m³).
One US gallon equals exactly 3.785411784 litres; the imperial gallon is 4.54609 litres.
A US cup is 236.588 ml; a US tablespoon is 14.787 ml; a teaspoon is 4.929 ml.
One fluid ounce is 29.5735 ml; 16 fl oz make a US pint.
This tool uses US customary kitchen units, the most common in online recipes.

faqs.q: How many litres are in a gallon?
faqs.a: A US gallon is 3.785411784 litres. The imperial (UK) gallon is larger at 4.54609 litres — this tool uses the US gallon.

faqs.q: How many ml in a cup?
faqs.a: A US cup is 236.588 ml. So 2 cups = 473.176 ml, about half a litre.

faqs.q: What is the difference between US and imperial gallons?
faqs.a: The US gallon (3.785 L) is smaller than the imperial gallon (4.546 L). Always check which gallon a recipe or manual means.

faqs.q: How many teaspoons in a tablespoon?
faqs.a: Exactly 3 teaspoons per tablespoon in US measure: 3 × 4.9289 ml = 14.7868 ml.

faqs.q: Is a litre the same as a cubic decimetre?
faqs.a: Yes, exactly. 1 litre = 1 dm³ = 0.001 m³ by definition.
